Description: Verify that the selection keeps the 100 domains with the highest Frequency and sends every GROUNDED cited URL of those domains to verification, with no URL cap. Covers AC-1. Backend-verifiable only (SKIP in UI runs).
Test name: TC-GEO-1169-001 - Top X domains by Frequency are selected and all their GROUNDED URLs sent to verification
Test step: Given a completed snapshot with more than 100 GROUNDED domains after the owned and competitor exclusion
Expected result: The snapshot and its reference ranking of domains by Frequency are available
QA Precondition: A completed snapshot exists with more than 100 GROUNDED domains after the owned and competitor exclusion. X is at its default value (100). A reference ranking of the snapshot domains by Frequency is available. Backend access to the selection job of the snapshot is available (selected domain list with Frequency, list of URLs sent to verification, selection log).

Test name: TC-GEO-1169-001 - Top X domains by Frequency are selected and all their GROUNDED URLs sent to verification
Test step: When the suspect selection runs over that snapshot
Expected result: The selection run completes and sets its SUSPECT_SELECTION done marker

Test name: TC-GEO-1169-001 - Top X domains by Frequency are selected and all their GROUNDED URLs sent to verification
Test step: Then exactly the 100 domains with the highest Frequency are selected
Expected result: The selected domain list contains 100 domains and matches the top 100 of the reference ranking

Test name: TC-GEO-1169-001 - Top X domains by Frequency are selected and all their GROUNDED URLs sent to verification
Test step: And every GROUNDED cited URL of those 100 domains is sent to verification
Expected result: The number of URLs sent to verification equals the number of distinct GROUNDED cited URLs of the 100 domains, with no cap applied

Test name: TC-GEO-1169-001 - Top X domains by Frequency are selected and all their GROUNDED URLs sent to verification
Test step: And no URL of a domain ranked below the top 100 and no non-GROUNDED citation is sent to verification
Expected result: None of the URLs sent to verification belongs to a domain ranked 101 or lower, and none comes from a non-GROUNDED citation

Description: Verify that owned and competitor domains are removed before the ranking, so they do not take a top X slot. Covers AC-1 (edge case). Backend-verifiable only (SKIP in UI runs).
Test name: TC-GEO-1169-002 - Owned and competitor domains are excluded before the top X ranking
Test step: Given a snapshot where an owned domain and a competitor domain rank in the top 100 by Frequency before exclusion
Test data: Owned domain: toyota.com, competitor domain: honda.com (Toyota analysis)
Expected result: Both domains are present in the reference ranking within the top 100
QA Precondition: The analysis has owned and competitor domains configured. In the snapshot, one owned domain and one competitor domain each have a Frequency within the top 100 before exclusion, and more than 102 GROUNDED domains exist in total. Backend access to the selection job of the snapshot is available (selected domain list with Frequency, list of URLs sent to verification, selection log).

Test name: TC-GEO-1169-002 - Owned and competitor domains are excluded before the top X ranking
Test step: When the suspect selection runs over that snapshot
Expected result: The selection run completes

Test name: TC-GEO-1169-002 - Owned and competitor domains are excluded before the top X ranking
Test step: Then neither the owned domain nor the competitor domain is selected
Expected result: toyota.com and honda.com are absent from the selected domain list and none of their URLs is sent to verification

Test name: TC-GEO-1169-002 - Owned and competitor domains are excluded before the top X ranking
Test step: And the selection still contains 100 domains, including the domains ranked 101 and 102 before the exclusion
Expected result: The selected domain list contains 100 domains and includes the two domains that ranked 101 and 102 in the ranking before exclusion

Description: Verify that the Frequency used for the selection ranking is the same value as the Frequency column of AI Citation Sources (unique URLs per domain). Covers AC-2. Backend-verifiable only (SKIP in UI runs).
Test name: TC-GEO-1169-003 - Selection Frequency matches the AI Citation Sources Frequency column
Test step: Given the selection output of the snapshot lists the selected domains with their Frequency
Test data: Domains ranked 1, 50 and 100 in the selection
Expected result: The Frequency of the 3 domains is recorded from the selection output
QA Precondition: A completed snapshot exists and its suspect selection has run. The AI Citation Sources table is opened on the same snapshot with a scope covering all markets, all engines and all question types. Backend access to the selection job of the snapshot is available (selected domain list with Frequency, list of URLs sent to verification, selection log).

Test name: TC-GEO-1169-003 - Selection Frequency matches the AI Citation Sources Frequency column
Test step: When the user opens the AI Citation Sources table of the same snapshot with all markets, all engines and all question types
Expected result: The table lists the domains with their Frequency column

Test name: TC-GEO-1169-003 - Selection Frequency matches the AI Citation Sources Frequency column
Test step: Then the Frequency of each of the 3 domains in the table equals the Frequency used by the selection
Expected result: The 3 Frequency values are identical in the table and in the selection output

Test name: TC-GEO-1169-003 - Selection Frequency matches the AI Citation Sources Frequency column
Test step: And the order of the selected domains matches the Frequency order of the table once owned and competitor domains are set aside
Expected result: The selected domains appear in the same relative order as in the AI Citation Sources table sorted by Frequency

Description: Verify that a domain with one URL cited many times ranks by its number of unique URLs, the same way as AI Citation Sources. Covers AC-2 (edge case). Backend-verifiable only (SKIP in UI runs).
Test name: TC-GEO-1169-004 - Frequency counts unique URLs, not citations
Test step: Given a snapshot where domain A has 1 URL cited in 30 answers and domain B has 5 distinct URLs cited once each
Test data: Domain A: 1 URL x 30 answers, domain B: 5 URLs x 1 answer
Expected result: Both domains are present in the snapshot citations
QA Precondition: A completed snapshot exists in which domain A has 1 distinct URL cited in 30 answers and domain B has 5 distinct URLs each cited in 1 answer. Both are GROUNDED, non-owned and non-competitor. Backend access to the selection job of the snapshot is available (selected domain list with Frequency, list of URLs sent to verification, selection log).

Test name: TC-GEO-1169-004 - Frequency counts unique URLs, not citations
Test step: When the suspect selection ranks the domains of the snapshot
Expected result: The selection ranking is produced

Test name: TC-GEO-1169-004 - Frequency counts unique URLs, not citations
Test step: Then domain A has a Frequency of 1 and domain B a Frequency of 5
Expected result: The selection output shows Frequency 1 for domain A and 5 for domain B, identical to the AI Citation Sources Frequency column

Test name: TC-GEO-1169-004 - Frequency counts unique URLs, not citations
Test step: And domain B ranks above domain A
Expected result: Domain B is placed above domain A in the selection ranking

Test name: TC-GEO-1169-006 - Positive-only source with a missing article is listed in Target Sources

Test name: TC-GEO-1169-007 - X is changed in configuration and applies to the next selection run
Test step: And the selection log shows X applied = 50
Expected result: The log of the run reports X = 50

Test name: TC-GEO-1169-007 - X is changed in configuration and applies to the next selection run

Test name: TC-GEO-1169-013 - Selection is idempotent per snapshot and keeps the done marker
